summary: Phase 4 backend testing complete. Created /app/backend/tests/test_phase4_files_schedule_orders_notif_commission.py with 48 tests covering Emergent Object Storage file upload/download/delete (12), Doctor weekly schedule template (6), Medicine purchase orders with 4% commission + stock + prescription validation (15), HTTP-polling notifications + auto-generation on order events (8), Commission/GMV summary for Pharmacy/Doctor/Engineer (5), plus 2 regression assertions. All 48 pass. Combined regression across all phases: 147/147 backend tests pass in 105s (20 auth+translate + 32 phase2 + 47 phase3 + 48 phase4). Real Emergent Object Storage round-trip verified (init, PUT, GET) using a tiny 1x1 PNG. Commission math (4% medicine, 12% consultation) verified end-to-end including aggregation pipeline. Cancelled orders correctly excluded from pharmacy GMV. Patient/pharmacy authorization on order status transitions enforced. Notifications auto-created on order placement AND on every status change. ?auth=token query param works on /api/files/{id} for use in tags.

minor.issue: Any valid JWT/session token can download ANY file_id (no owner/recipient check). Comment in code says 'profile pics are semi-public among users' but the same endpoint serves prescription files which are PHI/sensitive medical data. Should at minimum restrict prescription-purpose files to owner + the pharmacy on a matching order.

JWT decoding does not check signature audience/issuer; bare jwt.decode without verifying expiry independent of JWTError catch is fine, but the except clause catches the bare 'Exception' which masks unrelated bugs (e.g., db connectivity). Narrow to JWTError.

MAX_FILE_SIZE check happens AFTER full read into memory. A malicious client can POST a 5GB body and consume RAM before the 400 is returned. Use UploadFile.size or stream with chunk accumulator and abort early.
ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES trusts client-provided Content-Type header. No magic-byte/content sniffing. A .exe with Content-Type: image/png passes. Use python-magic or PIL.Image.open to verify.

No validation that start_time < end_time, no HH:MM regex on time strings, no check day_of_week is in 0..6, no overlap detection between slots on the same day. Pydantic ScheduleSlot uses bare str for times and bare int for day_of_week.

Stock decrement and order insert are NOT atomic. Race condition: two concurrent orders for last item both see stock=1, both succeed, stock goes to -1. Use findOneAndUpdate with $inc and stock>=qty filter to atomically reserve.
Status transitions are not validated as a state machine. Pharmacy can move 'delivered' -> 'pending' or 'cancelled' -> 'shipped'. Define allowed transitions per current status.
Cancelling an order does NOT restore the decremented medicine stock. Cancelled orders forfeit inventory.

Pharmacy can mark patient-cancelled order as 'shipped' afterwards (no check that current status is terminal). Also no check the patient cancels only while status='pending' (they could cancel after delivery).

Doctor consultation_fee is hardcoded to $30 in code; spec says 'in real app, doctor sets'. Should read from doctor profile (and fall back to 30). Currently every doctor gets identical revenue per video appt.

Doctor branch only counts appointment_type='video' and status='completed'. There is NO endpoint or mechanism in the codebase that sets status='completed' on an appointment — so doctor GMV will always be 0 in practice. Add a 'complete appointment' endpoint or auto-complete on video room close.
Returns commission for current_user only — no admin view of platform-wide GMV/commission. Spec mentions 'Commission/GMV tracking' as a platform feature.

action_items: (HIGH) Add owner/role-based authorization to GET /api/files/{file_id} for prescription-purpose files (currently any authenticated user can read anyone's prescription image by guessing/learning a file_id).
(HIGH) Make POST /api/orders atomic: use findOneAndUpdate({medicine_id, stock>=qty}, $inc: -qty) so two concurrent orders for last unit cannot both succeed.

(HIGH) Doctor commission GMV is permanently 0 because no endpoint ever sets appointment.status='completed'. Add POST /api/appointments/{id}/complete (or auto-complete when /video/rooms ends) so consultation revenue is tracked.
(MEDIUM) Validate ScheduleSlot fields (day_of_week 0..6, HH:MM regex, start<end, no same-day overlaps).
(MEDIUM) Implement order status state-machine: pending→confirmed→shipped→delivered, plus terminal cancelled; reject illegal transitions including post-cancel updates.
(MEDIUM) Restore medicine stock when an order is cancelled.
(MEDIUM) Enforce file size limit BEFORE reading the whole body into memory; sniff actual file magic bytes — don't trust Content-Type.
(LOW) Pull doctor consultation_fee from doctor profile instead of hardcoded $30 in /commission/summary.
(LOW) Add /admin/commission/summary (or role-gated path) for platform-level GMV view.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1669 lines (up from 1207). Still exceeds the 700-line guideline. Phase 4 added another ~440 lines without modularization. Split into routers/files.py, routers/schedule.py, routers/orders.py, routers/notifications.py, routers/commission.py and a shared storage_client module.

Object storage `storage_key` is a module-level global mutated by init_storage(); if the upstream session is invalidated mid-process there is no retry/refresh — every subsequent upload returns 502 until the worker is restarted. Wrap put_object/get_object in a single retry on 401/403 that re-runs init_storage().

The `download_file` exception handler catches bare `Exception` AND `JWTError` together in one except — masks errors during db.user_sessions.find_one (e.g. mongo timeout) as 'Invalid token'. Narrow to JWTError only.

Order creation calculates `commission_amount` and `pharmacy_payout` from `medicine.price` captured at order time (good — price-locked). But there's no `currency` field anywhere; if prices become multi-currency this breaks silently.
Notification documents don't have a TTL/cleanup. db.notifications grows unboundedly. Add TTL index on created_at (e.g. 90d) or paginate + archive.

/notifications query uses `created_at: {$gt: since}` where `since` is a raw user-provided string compared lexicographically against ISO strings — works for well-formed timezone-aware ISO but breaks silently with malformed input. Validate `since` as a datetime.
Commission rates COMMISSION_RATES are constants in code, not in DB or env. Operations team cannot change rates without a deploy. Consider storing in a `platform_config` collection.

/api/files/{file_id} returns the raw bytes with `record.content_type` but does NOT set Content-Disposition or Cache-Control. Browsers will not cache profile pictures, multiplying object-storage GETs on every page refresh.

Engineer role is allowed through /commission/summary (returns {gmv: 0}). Either restrict to Pharmacy+Doctor (consistent with the 'Not applicable' 403) or document equipment-listing commissions for engineers if planned.
test_credentials: doctor@test.com/Doctor123! (Doctor), patient@test.com/Patient123! (Patient), pharmacy@test.com/Pharmacy123! (Pharmacy), engineer@test.com/Engineer123! (Biomedical Engineer). All endpoints are idempotent on re-run; tests register users if absent.
seed_data_creation: Each run creates: 1 profile-picture file (replaces patient.picture), 2-3 prescription/general files (one soft-deleted), 1 doctor schedule (overwritten), 2 medicines (TEST_Paracetamol_<uuid>, TEST_Antibiotic_<uuid>) — these accumulate per run but are harmless. 2 orders (one delivered, one cancelled). Auto-creates 4 notifications per run (1 new_order + 3 order_update). No teardown — pharmacy commission GMV will grow ~$100/run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 4 endpoints work end-to-end including REAL Emergent Object Storage (init/put/get) — EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in backend/.env is valid for storage too. Tests use a 1x1 PNG (TINY_PNG hex constant) so storage uploads are fast. Commission math: pharmacy uses Mongo aggregate pipeline ($sum subtotal/commission/payout where status != cancelled), doctor counts completed video appointments * $30 * 12%. KEY GOTCHA: no endpoint in the codebase sets appointment.status='completed' so doctor.completed_consultations is always 0 — tests assert the shape, not a non-zero value. /api/files/{file_id} accepts BOTH Authorization: Bearer AND ?auth= query param (needed for ). The `auth` token verification is permissive — any valid token reads any file. Patient order cancellation does NOT restore stock. Combined regression file count: 4 test files, 147 tests, ~105s.
rca_of_the_issue: Not a single bug RCA this iteration — all reported items are pre-existing design/security gaps surfaced by review, not test failures. Top RCA: Doctor commission GMV permanently zero. Root cause: /commission/summary line 1605-1609 counts db.appointments where status='completed', but no endpoint in server.py ever updates an appointment to status='completed'. The set of writable statuses on /appointments is {pending, confirmed, cancelled} (from earlier phase). Fix: add POST /api/appointments/{id}/complete (doctor-only) that flips status, OR auto-complete when the linked video room reaches end_time, OR allow doctor to PATCH any appointment to 'completed' from /appointments/{id} update endpoint. Reproduction: doctor video-appointments → /commission/summary returns gmv=0 even after 100 calls.
